content='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The marked template is the largest connected non-background component.
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((len(comp),color,comp))
    _, color, comp=max(comps)
    r0=min(r for r,c in comp); c0=min(c for r,c in comp)
    mask={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in comp}; mh=max(r for r,c in mask)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in mask)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
        for c in range(w-mw+1):
            cells=[(r+dy,c+dx) for dy,dx in mask]
            if all(grid[y][x]==0 for y,x in cells):
                for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
